name: @mikeargento/bitgraph-sdk
description: The BitGraph SDK: record files and folders (one tree under one position, every file a leaf, with the export/1 that proves each one), check and fetch proofs, open a position before the work exists and seal the task under it, verify proofs, exports and BitGraphed files fully offline. One engine, three sockets: this library for TypeScript, the bitgraph CLI (every command speaks --json) for any language that can spawn a process, and bitgraph serve for a localhost API any runtime can call. Files are read locally and never uploaded; only digests, root documents and slot records leave the machine.
